# Universifit

> Universifit is a vetted 1-on-1 coaching platform and athletic curriculum marketplace connecting individuals with verified practitioners in strength biomechanics, clinical metabolic nutrition, posture restoration, and longevity protocols.

## Core Offerings

- **1-on-1 Consultations**: Private video coaching sessions with top 1% verified practitioners covering movement screening, form audits, and personalized protocols.
- **Masterclass Curriculums**: Structured video syllabi with sequential module progressions, downloadable spreadsheets, and coach feedback milestones.
- **Inner Circle Squads**: Private community circles for form audits, personal record celebrations, and peer accountability.
- **Buyer Protection**: 256-bit encrypted checkout via Razorpay, 14-day consultation refund window, and 30-day curriculum mastery guarantee.

## Key Navigation Links

- [Home](https://universifit.vercel.app/): Main landing page with featured practitioners, platform metrics, and core disciplines.
- [Discover Coaches](https://universifit.vercel.app/discover): Interactive directory of verified coaches filterable by discipline (strength, nutrition, posture, longevity) and goal.
- [Community](https://universifit.vercel.app/community): Athletic discussion feed, weekly PRs, and reputation score tracking.
- [Privacy Policy](https://universifit.vercel.app/privacy): Biometric data governance, encrypted telemetry storage, and zero third-party advertising policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://universifit.vercel.app/terms): Platform usage terms, coaching marketplace escrow terms, and creator payout guidelines.
- [Refund Policy](https://universifit.vercel.app/refund-policy): Transparent 14-day consultation refund policy and 30-day curriculum satisfaction guarantee.
- [Concierge Support](https://universifit.vercel.app/contact): Platform assistance desk for billing inquiries and coach application verification.

## Creator Verification Standards

Practitioners on Universifit are vetted through credential validation, coaching portfolio audits, and verified client case studies before listing 1-on-1 consultations or video syllabi.
